title: 第一卷 第5章 苏馨月落水
slug: 满门遗孀花甲老汉粮肉满仓
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林骁目光扫过三人，表情严肃说道：“家规首要一条，就是听话。”

苏馨月忙点头：“林伯放心，我们肯定都听您的。”

她悄悄扯了扯上官飞燕的袖子。

上官飞燕抿了抿唇，冷声道：“林老头，只要你肯给我清雪姐拿药，别说听话，让我给你端屎端尿都行。”

“飞燕！”苏馨月急道。

林骁却笑了：“好，这可是你说的。”

“我说的，咋了？”上官飞燕扬起下巴。

“林伯，您别介意，飞燕年纪小。”苏馨月忙打圆场。

“无妨，”林骁摆摆手，“我就喜欢你这泼辣劲儿。”

接着，林骁继续说道：“第二，家里活儿分工，馨月负责做饭、缝补；飞燕年轻，手脚勤快些，打扫院子、劈柴挑水；清雪身子弱，做些轻省活计，但每日需在院里走动，不可整日躺着。”

“第三，”他顿了顿，“未来不可轻信外面任何人，若是我发现，有人心怀二心，我会即刻将她赶出家门。”

上官飞燕呆呆看着他，半晌，小声问：“就……就这些？”

“不然呢？”林骁看她一眼，“你以为我要你们做什么？”

飞燕脸涨得通红，低下头不敢说话。

“好了，先把你们的东西归置好，馨月，你随我来，看看米面放在哪儿，往后做饭，你来掌勺。”

“是。”苏馨月忙跟上。

在讲完家规后，林骁准备进山打猎。

冷清雪忽然开口：“林伯，我随您一起。”

林骁看她一眼：“山里冷，你确定扛得住？”

“能。”冷清雪语气坚定。

林骁没再劝，

棉衣很旧，但厚实干净。

冷清雪怔了怔，低声道：“谢林伯。”

“万事小心。”苏馨月送他们到院门口，轻声嘱咐。

林骁点头，带着冷清雪往山里去。

林骁走在前头，冷清雪跟在后头，两人隔着几步距离。

山路难行，冷清雪身子弱，走得慢，不时掩口轻咳，林骁放慢脚步，等她跟上。

“你的肺疾，怎么落下的？”林骁询问。

冷清雪沉默片刻，道：“三年前，北境侦察，中了埋伏，胸口挨了一刀，又掉进冰河，救上来后，便落下这病根。”

“你既从过军，箭术如何？”

“三十步内，箭无虚发。”冷清雪声音里带着些许傲气，“五十步，十中七八。”

“现在呢？”

冷清雪沉默。

“拉得开弓吗？”

“……勉强。”

林骁停下，转身看她。

女子面色苍白，身形单薄，但背脊挺得笔直，眼神锐利如刀。

“想不想再提弓？”

冷清雪与他对视，缓缓点头。

“好。”林骁从背上取下自己的弓，递给她，“试试。”

这是一把旧弓，弓身是硬木，弦是牛筋，保养得很好。

冷清雪接过，入手沉甸甸的。

她深吸一口气，搭箭，开弓。

手臂在抖。

弓只拉开一半，她便脸色发白，胸口剧烈起伏，咳了起来。

林骁上前，伸手托住她持弓的手：“腰沉，肩松，力从地起。”

他手掌温热，带着厚茧。

冷清雪身子一僵，但没躲开。

“呼吸，吸气时蓄力，呼气时放箭。”林骁耐心教导。

冷清雪依言调整呼吸，再开弓。

这次，弓弦被缓缓拉满。

“放。”

箭离弦，钉在十丈外的树干上，入木三分。

冷清雪喘着气，额头冒出细汗，但眼睛亮了。

Page (1/3)

Lin Xiao glanced at the three of them and said with a serious expression: "The first rule of the house is to be obedient."

Su Xinyue nodded hurriedly: "Don't worry, Uncle Lin, we will definitely listen to you."

She quietly tugged on Guan Feiyan's sleeve.

Shangguan Feiyan pursed her lips and said in a cold voice: "Old man Lin, as long as you are willing to get medicine for my sister Qingxue, don't be obedient and let me carry your shit and urinate for you."

"Feiyan!" Su Xinyue said anxiously.

Lin Xiao smiled: "Okay, this is what you said."

"I said, what's wrong?" Shangguan Feiyan raised her chin.

"Uncle Lin, don't mind, Feiyan is young." Su Xinyue was busy trying to smooth things over.

"It doesn't matter," Lin Xiao waved his hand, "I just like your aggressiveness."

Then, Lin Xiao continued: "Second, the division of labor at home, Xinyue is responsible for cooking and sewing; Feiyan is young and more diligent with hands and feet, cleaning the yard, chopping firewood and carrying water; Qingxue is weak, so she does light work, but she needs to walk around the yard every day and cannot lie down all day."

"Third," he paused, "don't trust anyone outside in the future. If I find someone with double-minded intentions, I will immediately kick her out of the house."

Shangguan Feiyan looked at him blankly for a long time, then asked in a low voice: "That's it...that's all?"

"Otherwise?" Lin Xiao glanced at her, "What do you think I want you to do?"

Feiyan's face turned red and she lowered her head and did not dare to speak.

"Okay, let's put your things away first. Xinyue, come with me and see where the rice and noodles are. From now on, you will be in charge of cooking."

"Yes." Su Xinyue hurriedly followed.

After explaining the family rules, Lin Xiao prepared to go hunting in the mountains.

Leng Qingxue suddenly said: "Uncle Lin, I will come with you."

Lin Xiao glanced at her: "It's cold in the mountains, are you sure you can handle it?"

"Yes." Leng Qingxue said firmly.

Lin Xiao didn't persuade him any more.

The cotton coat is old, but thick and clean.

Leng Qingxue was stunned and whispered: "Thank you, Uncle Lin."

"Be careful in everything." Su Xinyue escorted them to the entrance of the hospital and whispered.

Lin Xiao nodded and took Leng Qingxue to the mountains.

Lin Xiao walked in front, and Leng Qingxue followed behind, with a few steps between them.

The mountain road was difficult to walk, and Leng Qingxue was weak and walked slowly. She covered her mouth and coughed lightly from time to time. Lin Xiao slowed down and waited for her to catch up.

"How did you develop your lung disease?" Lin Xiao asked.

Leng Qingxue was silent for a moment and said: "Three years ago, while scouting in the north, I was ambushed. I was stabbed in the chest and fell into the glacier. After I was rescued, I fell into this disease."

"Since you have been in the army, how are your archery skills?"

"Within thirty steps, the arrows will be flawless." Leng Qingxue said with a little arrogance in her voice, "Fifty steps, seven or eight out of ten."

"What now?"

Leng Qingxue was silent.

"Can you draw the bow?"

"...barely."

Lin Xiao stopped and turned to look at her.

The woman was pale and thin, but her back was straight and her eyes were as sharp as knives.

"Do you want to lift the bow again?"

Leng Qingxue looked at him and nodded slowly.

"Okay." Lin Xiao took his bow from his back and handed it to her, "Try it."

This is an old bow with a hardwood body and beef tendon strings, and it's been well maintained.

Leng Qingxue took it and held it heavily.

She took a deep breath, nocked her arrow, and fired her bow.

The arms are shaking.

When the bow was only halfway drawn, her face turned pale, her chest heaved violently, and she started coughing.

Lin Xiao stepped forward and stretched out his hand to hold her bow hand: "The waist is heavy, the shoulders are loose, but the strength rises from the ground."

His palms were warm and calloused.

Leng Qingxue stiffened, but did not move away.

"Breathe, accumulate strength when you inhale, and release the arrow when you exhale." Lin Xiao taught patiently.

Leng Qingxue adjusted her breathing as instructed and opened her bow again.

This time, the bowstring was slowly drawn to full capacity.

"Let it go."

The arrow left the string, was nailed to the tree trunk ten feet away, and penetrated three-thirds of the way into the wood.

Leng Qingxue panted, sweat broke out on his forehead, but his eyes were bright.
